sources.title: National Park Service, Statue of Liberty National Monument, "Statue Statistics"

heightM.note: ground to tip of torch, 305 ft 1 in

statueM.note: top of base to torch, 151 ft 1 in (Wikidata height 46 m)

pedestalTopM.note: ground to the top of the pedestal, 154 ft (Wikidata gives the pedestal 47 m)

pedestalM.note: the granite pedestal alone, the commonly given 89 ft; the fort below takes the rest of the 46.94 m

heelToHeadM.note: heel to top of head, 111 ft 1 in

armM.note: right arm: width 12 ft (widthM), length 42 ft (depthM)

tablet.note: tablet 13 ft 7 in wide (widthM) by 23 ft 7 in long (depthM), 2 ft thick

pedestalPlan.note: the pedestal's base (widthM) and top (depthM) width, proportioned by eye

fort.note: the eleven-point star fort's outer (widthM) and inner (depthM) diameter, proportioned by eye

readabilityScale.note: The figure is drawn as plain volumes (robe, head, crown rays, raised arm, torch, tablet); crown rays are slim spikes.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights and widths x1.8, so the statue reads from Battery Park at the 3,000-4,500 m game camera (S07b acceptance).
